| Category = Pork recipes

}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (4 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]]) boneless [[Cookbook:Pork#Loin|pork loin]] roast, trimmed of excess fat
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] salt
* 2 cups boiling apple [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]
* 1 pound ice cubes
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 2 tbsp light [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 2 tbsp dehydrated lemon peel
* 2 tbsp black [[Cookbook:Pepper|peppercorns]], cracked
* Forearm-sized hickory wood chunks
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine salt, honey, and vinegar in a 6-quart container. Add ice, cover, and shake until ice is mostly melted and brine has cooled.
#Add pork roast, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat, and weigh down if needed. Refrigerate 3–3.5 hours.
#Take roast out of brine; rinse with cold water. Pat dry with [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]] and set aside.
#Combine seasonings and sugar. Press into all sides of meat. Set aside.
#Preheat smoker to 200°F with the hickory chunks. Add roast, cover, and cook until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium rare.
#Remove to a plate and cover tightly with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]]. Let rest 15 minutes before serving.
